text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite returning to the turf training
track,
Satono Diamond's running is still
off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In fact, her form has deteriorated
significantly, as
have her lap times.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...
Tell me honestly, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Do you think I'll be able to shape up
before the
autumn Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't need to be perfect for the
Kyoto
Daishoten, as it's only a warm-up
race, but there
isn't much time left until
the autumn Tenno Sho.
choice_data_list: Even if we finish it now, it's going to cut it close.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to go back to how I was
running before.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to run like this in my race
with
McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reverting her running style must be an
agonizing
decision. To honor her
feelings, I must ensure
she's in her best
condition before the autumn
Tenno Sho.
choice_data_list: Yeah. We'll make it in time for the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
Yeah. We'll make it in time for the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Why?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I was much faster before, so this should
work,
but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she isn't able to run like she
used to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Overfocusing on reverting to her
previous running
style only serves to
upset her balance, making her
flustered
and more self-conscious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how we can break her out of
this vicious
cycle. If Satono Diamond has
forgotten how she
used to run, then
there's only one thing for me to
do.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hello! What did you want to talk to me
about?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I think I know what you're talking
about. I've
noticed that her form's been
off recently.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I briefly explain about how Satono
Diamond
hasn't had much luck trying to
go back to her
previous way of running.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see. In that case, why don't I do some
running
with her?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I dunno how to fix her problem, but if
we run
together, we might figure
something out!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You want me to run with you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I wanna run 2,200 meters, the
same
distance as the Takarazuka Kinen,
and revisit the
training I did back then.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: What do you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
All right. That distance is right between
the
length of the autumn Tenno Sho and
the Kyoto
Daishoten, so it'll be good
training for me too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you. I should be the one thanking
you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Satono Diamond and Kitasan
Black begin
their 2,200-meter run.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I have to increase my pace a little so I
don't get
left behind...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah! Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I can't close our gap! Are my steps
landing too
hard? It's no good! I'm
falling farther behind!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (I can't run properly...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hm... You don't seem like your usual
self.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Well, there's no need to push yourself.
Let's call it
a day for now!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No, I want to keep going...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But it didn't feel like you were able to

concentrate on our run.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You might get injured if you're
distracted, so let's
end things here for
now, okay?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okay... I understand. Thanks for the run.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's call it a day. Get plenty of rest.
Yeah, let's wrap it up. Get some good rest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond must be wary of getting
injured
because she nods without further
argument.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hey, since it's still early, let's take a
detour on the
way back!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but I―

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Come on!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Wait, I―

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm starving! Let's head to the shopping
district
first!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Mmm! This is delicious!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Which flavors did you get, Dia?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Half chili cheese dog and half mint
chocolate
chip.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
There you go again with another of your
weird
flavor combinations...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The unexpected pairing seemed
interesting to me!
The sweet and spicy
mix packs quite a surprising
flavor
profile. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You're braver than I am!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm thirsty, so let's go grab some drinks!
We
should enjoy them somewhere with a
nice view!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita! You're going to make me drop my
taiyaki if
you yank on my hand like that
out of nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Sorry! But you didn't drop it, did you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Even since we were young, Kita has
been leading
me by the hand like this...)

text_block_list.name: Young Dia
text_block_list.text: Kita... How far do we still have to go?

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text: Just a little more. Look!

text_block_list.name: Young Dia
text_block_list.text: Whoa! We're so high up!

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
This is my special spot! I wanted to show
you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(She's taken me to so many different
places...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... It's pretty exhausting climbing up here without taking any breaks, huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, it really is... Pant, huff...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This place... You took me by the hand
and
brought me here a long time ago,
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just here either. You took me to
so many
places. You were the one who
introduced me to
the outside world.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've always thought of you as an older
sister.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You know, I've always tried to act
like your
older sister when I'm with you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I want to walk before you so I can lead
the way...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hey, Dia! Race you to the riverbank!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why do you want to race me all of
a
sudden?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter, let's just do it! Ready,
set, GO!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hold o—no fair!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I win! All right! Next, let's race to
the park!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: What?! Oh, come on!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Let's go! I'm gonna leave you behind!

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, Dia! Hurry up! I'm gonna leave
you
behind!

text_block_list.name: Young Dia
text_block_list.text: Wait, Kita! Slow down!

text_block_list.name: Young Dia
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Hehe! Just a little more!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff... I won't let you leave me behind!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Right! Last up, the dorm! That'll be our
finish line!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I'm going to catch you this time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I used to run with my eyes trained on
her back
like this long ago...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(All I wanted to do was to catch up to
Kita.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: All riiight!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Huh? I'm... I'm running properly...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I'm running naturally without thinking
about
anything!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I see... I've always just run while
engrossed in my
chase after Kita...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(And I would do it while imagining the
look on her
face when I caught up and
passed her.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (It's so fun... Running is fun!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Gooooal!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hey, Kita...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! That was fun!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I had fun too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'll pass you next time for sure!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hehe! As if I'd let you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I simply have to run with my all heart,
just like I
did back then...)
